statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-128241: in -d output mode the xmlwf tool in libexpat through 2.10.0 opens its output files with fopen("wb"), which follows a symbolic link planted at the expected output name, so a local attacker with write access to the output directory can truncate or overwrite files the xmlwf user can write (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-128241). Upstream fixed it in libexpat pull request #1502 (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1502), commits 7e52b22 (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/7e52b22b6462c8384d4bae60cc8fdbdaff30237b) and 26f00fc (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/commit/26f00fc7b173cb89d349adc04f453579e2c48db4), which open the output with O_NOFOLLOW and mode 0600 and wrap the descriptor with fdopen. It is released in Expat 2.11.0 (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/blob/R_2_11_0/expat/Changes), and Debian lists only unstable's 2.11.0-1 as fixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-128241). DHI backported both commits to expat 2.10.0 for Alpine 3.23 in build 2.10.0-r2. The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository publishes expat builds 2.7.3-r0, 2.7.4-r0, 2.7.5-r0, 2.8.1-r0, 2.8.2-r0, 2.8.3-r0, 2.8.3-r1, 2.8.4-r0, 2.8.5-r0, 2.8.5-r1, 2.9.0-r1, 2.10.0-r1 and 2.10.0-r2. Every build before 2.10.0-r1 was published before the upstream fix was written. On x86_64 and aarch64, /usr/bin/xmlwf in the expat package of 2.10.0-r2 imports fdopen and that of 2.10.0-r1 does not. We also ran xmlwf -d against an output directory holding a symbolic link at the output name: 2.10.0-r1 writes through the link and overwrites its target, and 2.10.0-r2 refuses and leaves the target unchanged. The request also matches 2.9.0-r0, which the DHI Alpine 3.23 repository does not publish and which sorts below the boundary. The range ends at 2.10.0-r2, the first published build with the fix.

Upstream fixed CVE-2026-128241 (xmlwf -d output mode opened files with fopen, following a symlink planted at the output name) in libexpat PR #1502, commits 7e52b22 and 26f00fc (https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1502), which open the output file with O_NOFOLLOW, create it with mode 0600 and wrap the descriptor with fdopen. No Expat release carries it yet and Debian lists it as unfixed (https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-128241). DHI backported both commits to its Debian 13 expat 2.9.0-1~deb13u1 packages: in the range's fixed version, on amd64 and arm64, /usr/bin/xmlwf in the expat package imports fdopen and no longer imports fopen, while the earlier 2.8.2, 2.8.3 and 2.9.0 builds still import fopen; those builds and the older builds of upstream 2.7.1, which predate the upstream fix, stay on the affected side of the range.
